rows.summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has submitted copy of Newspaper Publications.

rows.title: Acquisition
rows.summary: AUROPHARMA: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange about incorporation of a new wholly owned subsidiary by the name of  Avogent Lifesciences Private Limited  in India by Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.

rows.title: Press Release
rows.summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 31, 2026, titled "Lannett Company LLC, a wholly owned step down subsidiary of the Company announces launch of generic version of Advair Diskus® in the US".
